role: nine-family six-expert heterogeneous semantic consensus LOFO

semantic_features.summary: full/null candidate mean and population standard deviation after fixed projection

limitations: All nine validation families are consumed and cannot support a fresh release claim.
The six canonical experts are shared across folds; route fitting and threshold calibration alone hold out sources.
HellaSwag contributes route examples but no expert because its specialist failed the frozen gate.
Unanimous seed agreement is an empirical risk control, not a formal guarantee on unseen families.
The router sees frozen candidate representations and behavior summaries, but never source identity, labels or sample IDs.
